name: span_merge_rebuild
description: Structurally different but behaviorally equivalent solution: instead of three sequential re.sub passes (each rescanning the already-partially-redacted string), it collects every match span from all three patterns with finditer, merges overlapping/adjacent spans, and rebuilds the string once by slicing around the merged spans. Different algorithm and control flow (collect-then-rebuild vs. chained substitution), same observable masking behavior.
